parameters.note: Round Top Lake is not listed in CCR §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), so it falls under the general statewide lake regulation in §5.85(a)(1). Access is seasonal in practice (limited by snow), but there is no regulatory closed season.

candidates.summary: Open all year (general statewide lake regulation; not listed as a special-regulation water)

candidates.authorityName: USDA Forest Service (Eldorado National Forest, Mokelumne Wilderness)
candidates.citation: Eldorado NF — Lost Cabin Mine Trail (Round Top Lake), Trail 17E47 — Rules

parameters.description: Round Top Lake is within the Mokelumne Wilderness (Eldorado National Forest), reached via the Lost Cabin Mine Trail (17E47) from the Woods Lake trailhead off Highway 88. Campfires are prohibited anywhere in the wilderness, group size is limited (12 day-use / 8 overnight), pets must be leashed, and a Wilderness Permit is required for overnight camping.

candidates.summary: Wilderness access rules apply: no campfires anywhere in the Mokelumne Wilderness, leashed pets only, day-use/overnight group size limits, and a Wilderness Permit is required for overnight camping.

events.sizeNote: Fingerling-sized. CDFW's 2018-2020 Angler Survey Box Analysis reports this as the last recorded stocking at Round Top Lake, in September 2020 — half the quantity of the prior (2018) allotment, a reduction CDFW made given the lake's limited overwintering habitat (measured depth of only 2.1 m/6.9 ft in a 2012 gill-net survey) and resources available for fish. This is a historical, documented event, not a confirmed recurring annual stocking — Round Top Lake does not appear in CDFW's current (2026) Provisional Stocking Document.
